adjudication.conclusion: 5 of 6 arm-side replay_mismatch records sit at positions where the live environment returned the identical frame_hash across independent sessions; the remaining 1 lie past the point where the sessions diverge (prefix divergence) and carry no cross-session evidence either way. Structurally the verdict is the same for all 6: certify.py compares the manual's prediction against a single recorded observation, so a replay_mismatch is a statement about the theory, not about environment determinism

ar25_live_depth: the S31 live session is RESET-only: it participates at position 0 only (16 of the 388 pairwise comparisons involve it); positions 1-8 are archive-era sessions agreeing with each other (the P-9 result reproduced)
